coaching.headline: Zinx and Lt. Belica never died and the enemy never won a fight; every major and ten structures to one went allied.

flags.text: Zinx: 18 kills, zero deaths, a damn clinic, including four kills in the 5-0 teamfight.
Khaimera secured all three Fangtooths, Mini Prime and Orb Prime, with 64364 objective damage, the game's most.
Lt. Belica razed the enemy mid inner plus the duo and mid inhibitors, three of the ten structures.
Sounder draft: Riktor was the match's only real tank; the tankless enemy shape won 48.6% in ranked.

focus.title: Cash every won fight
focus.action: After each won fight, Khaimera calls the nearest standing tower or pit, and Zinx and Riktor walk there with the team before farming or backing.

20.3.call: Won 5-1 through the allied jungle and the enemy half of mid, and Zinx took the enemy mid outer between the kills. Keep the group on mid for the inner next.

22.7.call: Won 2-0 on the duo lane in the enemy half; Zinx took the enemy duo inner while Feng Mao took the allied mid outer. Tower for tower, a tier deeper.

29.6.call: Two separate plays: Lt. Belica killed Argus in the enemy base and Akeron killed Feng Mao in the allied jungle, then Fangtooth and the Core fell together. Clean close.

89b5ea5a-cf67-406a-8b52-deb6f3542300: Killed Argus and Murdock five times each. No tower or major objective came within 90 seconds of the 5-0 teamfight near the Fangtooth pit; start Fangtooth if up.
8.5 CS per minute against a 10.3 norm. When no tower or pit is up after a fight, clear the nearest wave before backing.
d69e76db-a39b-4854-8ab2-bafa967e4289: 66084 damage mitigated, the most of all ten, with 21 assists for 66% kill participation. When Feng Mao dives Zinx, hold Skewer for Feng Mao.
10 wards against a 14.8 norm while Argus placed 18. Before each Fangtooth or Prime, fill the Rift Walkers ward cap around the pit.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Three rotation kills on Argus, each followed by a tower, Fangtooth or the Core. Repeat that trip whenever the duo lane fights.
Feng Mao took the allied mid outer, the only allied structure lost, after the duo-lane kill on Argus. Before leaving mid, check where Feng Mao is.
7dc57052-fff4-4f0d-b4bd-2925186e92ff: Took the enemy offlane outer, with 8972 objective damage second only to Khaimera and 12.3 CS per minute on a 9.5 norm. Keep that side pressure while towers stand.
Two kills on Mourn and zero deaths, but one assist all game. Once the enemy offlane outer is down, join the next mid or duo fight.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: 90 enemy-jungle units killed and 9 CS per minute on a 7.2 norm. Keep invading whenever Feng Mao shows on a lane.
Died first in two won fights, to Argus and Gideon; hero damage ran 423 per minute on a 633 norm. Next fight, let Riktor's Skewer land, then Cull.

matchup: Duo was Zinx and Riktor against Murdock and Argus; Murdock's only two kills landed on Riktor and Khaimera.
Mourn healed 21564, the game's most; the only allied anti-heal, Akeron's Tainted Charm, came late and left the final build.
build: Prophecy and Orion are two of the 61.2% winning core; Spectra is not in the final build.
Cursed Ring raises total attack speed but makes basic attacks deal less damage.
Sky Splitter, finished last, was not active in earlier fights.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after damaging a hero below a health threshold; Forage adds gold and XP per minion or monster kill.
Weald is the most played Zinx carry Eternal, the only one with enough games; Forage with Barkskin is the best pair.
augment: Terminal Treatment raises Refibrillator's on-hit damage based on the target's missing health.
Terminal Treatment is the most played Zinx carry augment; no other option has enough games.
crest: Typhoon stacks attack speed on basic-attack hits and dashes a short distance at full stacks.
Typhoon is the most played Zinx carry crest; no rival has enough games.
improvement: Lane into Murdock runs 49.8% over 26 games with no unmet need; no build change proven.
Barkskin over Taproot matches the best Weald pair: damage back at heroes basic-attacking Zinx, giving up on-hit healing.
If Mourn's healing drags fights out, Tainted Totem for Onixian Quiver cuts target healing on any damage dealt.

matchup: Duo lane went allied: first blood, first Fangtooth, and one duo death before minute ten against three.
Argus's Dread Nova stuns enemies in a small area; Resonant Repair answers with healing and tenacity when Riktor is immobilized.
build: Vortex Stone, Forticus and Transference are the full 58.5% winning core.
Vortex Stone triggers on immobilizing heroes: Riktor's current basic cooldowns drop and Riktor gains a shield.
Void Conduit grants Riktor and a nearby allied hero omnivamp and missing-mana regeneration.
eternal: Knell shreds both armors with Rust stacks on hero hits and grants Riktor a share of the armor shredded.
Nihil, Knell and Idrisil are a toss-up for Riktor support; Patina with Resonant Repair, as ran, is the best Knell pair.
augment: Zap O' 9-Chains makes the next basic attack after an ability cast zap nearby enemies.
Zap O' 9-Chains and Wanton Warden are a toss-up, Zap O' 9-Chains in front. Sound keep.
crest: Rift Walkers' active dashes forward and pulls nearby heroes; the Visionary passive raises the ward cap.
Sanctification and Rift Walkers are a toss-up in the Riktor support field. Sound keep.
improvement: Core complete and no unmet need into Argus, a 53.9% lane over 219 games; no change proven.
Sanctification is the toss-up alternative: a team shield with tenacity, giving up the dash and pull.

matchup: Lane opponent was Gideon, who finished with one kill, on Khaimera, and never killed Lt. Belica.
Four of eight kills landed on Argus, three on rotations off mid.
Gideon's Black Hole pulls nearby enemies toward the center while Gideon channels.
build: Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings are the full core into Gideon, 52.6% over 137 games.
Amulet Of Chaos, finished last, cuts current basic cooldowns and restores mana on takedowns; earlier fights ran without Amulet Of Chaos.
eternal: Lotus randomly grants damage, haste, speed or health over time and on takedowns; Flawless heals nearby allies on ability hits.
Lotus leans first in the Lt. Belica mid field; Early Bloom with Immaculate is the best Lotus pair.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience that grows with hero level.
Combat Veteran is clearly the best Lt. Belica mid augment. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Soulbearer and Epoch lead a toss-up in the Lt. Belica mid field, Soulbearer in front. Sound keep.
improvement: Oblivion Crown completes the 61.5% core over 117 games: more magical power instead of Amulet Of Chaos's takedown cooldown cuts.
Early Bloom with Immaculate over Flawless with Fragrance: an extra level and damage reduction at high health, giving up the ally heal.

matchup: Lane opponent was Mourn; Akeron killed Mourn twice and never died.
Akeron took 22712 of 28062 hero damage as magical; Mourn's Beguile mesmerizes in a radius that grows while channeled.
build: Void Helm meets the magical-armor need into Mourn and raises all healing Akeron receives.
None of the 76.6% core, Fist Of Razuul, Fire Blossom and Forticus, made the build.
Painweaver, the last item finished, stacks physical penetration and movement speed on every ability cast.
eternal: Xyris adds bonus damage that grows with units killed; Dominance heals on takedowns.
Nihil is clearly the best Akeron offlane Eternal; Xyris has too few games to lead.
Dominance with Cull the Weak, as ran, is the best Xyris pair.
augment: Death From Above allows one extra web shot from a wall or the ground, to leap again or root.
Death From Above is the most played Akeron offlane augment; no rival has enough games to lead.
crest: Brutallax's active cleanses debuffs and grants tenacity, extended by basic-attack hits.
Brutallax has too few Akeron offlane games to rank; Nyr Warboots leans first.
improvement: Forticus, bought more into Mourn than usual, wins 56.9% over 1211 games and was not built.
Nihil over Xyris is the field-backed swap: power and armors that grow through hero fights, giving up farm-scaling damage.
Nyr Warboots swaps Brutallax's cleanse for a speed burst and regeneration; that path starts at Titan Crest, not Warrior Crest.

matchup: Jungle opponent was Feng Mao, who died ten times with zero kills; Khaimera scored two of those deaths.
Khaimera's three deaths went to Argus, Gideon and Murdock, all inside detected fights.
build: Overlord cleaves around the target on basic attacks and gains permanent health from kills.
Draconum adds physical armor and heals on takedowns; no item or the crest adds magical armor.
Sky Splitter's on-hit damage scales with the target's current health.
eternal: Knell shreds both armors on hero hits; Peal adds ultimate haste and maximum Rust after the ultimate.
Lotus leans first for Khaimera jungle; Knell has too few games to lead, and Frequency with Peal is the best Knell pair.
augment: Jungle Invasion grants physical power in any jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion and Feral Ambush are a toss-up, Jungle Invasion in front. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active hits an area around Khaimera and heals on hero hits.
Pacifier and Gravitum lead a toss-up in the Khaimera jungle field; Judgement ranks fourth.
improvement: Malady, Terminus and Necrosis is the 64.2% core over 109 games; none of the three made the build.
Lotus over Knell is the field lean: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up the armor shred.
Gravitum keeps the Champion Crest path and grounds the first hero hit, giving up Judgement's area heal.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
Dive threat on our backline: Feng Mao. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Zinx) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun chain → Bad Medicine slows → basics to proc Triage Protocol → Infuse heal → Neural Regenesis on the ally about to die
ourKits.winCondition: keep allies alive with Infuse and Neural Regenesis while Ricochet stuns open picks
ourKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Triage Protocol; at max it gives decaying speed and stronger Infuse
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: Infuse is aimed at allies, so dive her; bait Neural Regenesis before committing burst, avoid grouping in Ricochet's bounce chain, and buy anti-heal

ourKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
ourKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
ourKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
ourKits.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
ourKits.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
ourKits.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slows, the empowered basic attaches a Cosmic Tether that roots, Cosmic Rift lands on the rooted target, then Black Hole drags the group together
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole and Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for area burst
enemyKits.passive: hitting a hero with an ability empowers his next basic attack to tether the target, dealing damage then rooting them
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst

enemyKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
enemyKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
enemyKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
enemyKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

enemyKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
enemyKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash in, Hamstring twice to slow, Safeguard to block the key ability, then Earth Shatter to execute and recast on a kill
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with Safeguard up and chain Earth Shatter executes and Reaping Dash cooldown resets in fights
enemyKits.passive: unique hero takedowns permanently grant bonus physical penetration, and all his physical penetration is increased
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's Spellshield before committing your key CC; back off when low, since Earth Shatter executes and recasts on a kill; armor counters his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

checks.text: Matched or beat their tanks (1 v 0).
One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Riktor can stay with the carry and peel.

teamComp.summary: Draft: 1 tank, 1 diver vs their 0 tanks, 1 diver. In 1.18 ranked, our shape won 50.6% and theirs 48.6%.

cc.note: Crowd control was close: 9 hard-CC abilities for us, 8 for them.

chains suppress (1.25s) as Seismic Assault ends

steps.what: holds suppress for the diver on Zinx

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 30 minutes, fewer deaths than about 98% of Zinx carry players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Neural Regenesis at top rank: 120s base, about 82.8s by the end (31% shorter) from 45 ability haste: Prophecy 15, Orion 15, Magnify 15.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Zinx dealt 28,276 hero damage, 26% of their team's, with +250 magical power from items.
Prophecy (item): On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.
Orion (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Deal 2% increased damage to the Target for 3.5s, up to a maximum of 16%.
Cursed Ring (item): Increase your Total Attack Speed by 1.2x. Your Basic Attacks deal 25% less damage.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Ranged Basic Attack: Fire 2 additional projectiles. Each deals 10-35% (increases with Range) () Damage. Can Critically Strike and apply Lifesteal.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Melee Heroes only: Increase your Total Critical Strike Chance by 25%. Gain 1% Damage Mitigation for every 10% Missing Health.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Sustain: 14% lifesteal; 8% omnivamp; 6,318 healing recorded.
Toughness: +300 health; took 20,937 damage, mitigated 10,298, died 0 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Prophecy, Orion, Cursed Ring, Onixian Quiver, Sky Splitter.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Magnify, Onixian Quiver, Sky Splitter.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Zinx killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Argus, Murdock. We killed Zinx 0 times.
Copy it? Too few Zinx carry games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Neural Regenesis came back about every 83s instead of 120s by the end (31% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

duoLane.firstBlood: us (zinx on argus, in the duo lane)

gameFlags.summary: the sounder draft: 1 tank, 1 diver vs 0 tanks, 1 diver
evidence: Us 1 tank, 1 diver (50.6% in 1.18 ranked) vs them 0 tanks, 1 diver (48.6%).

bullets: Cursed Ring's 1.2x attack speed meant more Refibrillator hits, so Prophecy and Sky Splitter on-hit damage landed more often and Orion ramped faster, despite 25% weaker basic attacks.
Onixian Quiver fires 2 extra projectiles per ranged shot, each able to apply lifesteal, while Orion ramps damage on one target up to 16%.
Prophecy, Orion and Magnify gave 45 ability haste, cutting Neural Regenesis from 120s to about 82.8s, so the revive was ready for Zinx or an ally more often.
Riplash's pull and Skewer's suppression immobilize heroes, setting off Vortex Stone when off cooldown: current basic ability cooldowns drop 20% and Riktor gains a shield.
Electrocute's shield, Vortex Stone's shield and Forticus's cooldown-gated shield all fed Transference: an expiring shield returns 50% of the leftover value as health over 3s.
Vortex Stone, Void Conduit and Galaxy Greaves gave 30 ability haste, cutting Skewer from 85s to about 65.4s, so the cooldown-freezing suppression returned sooner.

coachLean.headline: We took the first tower on the duo lane, then turned six of nine won fights into a tower, inhibitor or Fangtooth.

flags.text: We took six towers, three inhibitors and the core; they took only our mid outer tower.
Zinx went 18/0/6 on 28,276 hero damage; Murdock and Argus died 9 times each.
Khaimera put up 64,364 objective damage and we took every pit: three Fangtooths, Mini Prime, Orb Prime.
The draft gave us the game's only real tank in Riktor; their lineup had none.

focus.action: Turn every won fight into the nearest tower or pit, and open teamfights with Skewer, then Seismic Assault, then Cull, so Zinx pays off inside the lockdown.
